name: School of Divination
summary: Seers who glimpse the future and bend it with portents.

features.name: Divination Savant
features.short: Copy divination spells for half the time and gold.
features.summary: The gold and time you must spend to copy a divination spell into your spellbook is halved.

features.name: Portent
features.short: After a long rest, roll two d20s to replace any rolls later.
features.summary: When you finish a long rest, roll two d20s and record the numbers. You can replace any attack roll, saving throw or ability check made by you or a creature you can see with one of these rolls, once per roll, before it is made. At 14th level you roll three.

features.name: Expert Divination
features.short: Casting divination spells refunds a lower slot.
features.summary: When you cast a divination spell of 2nd level or higher using a slot, you regain one expended slot of a lower level (no higher than 5th).

features.name: The Third Eye
features.short: Action: darkvision, ethereal sight, read languages or see invisible.
features.summary: As an action, choose one benefit until your next rest: darkvision 60 ft., see into the Ethereal Plane 60 ft., read any language, or see invisible creatures within 10 ft. Once per short or long rest.

features.name: Greater Portent
features.summary: You roll three d20s for your Portent feature instead of two.
